newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates steady, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates steady, seen falling.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Thursday but are likely to fall amid rising supplies from the new 1997/98 (July-June) crop, dealers said.
"The fear about the quality after the monsoon rains has helped maintain the rates but rising fresh arrivals are likely to pull the rates down in the near term," dealer Mustafa Hussain said.
In the kerb market, the new-crop NIAB-78 variety ranged between 2,200 ($54.16) and 2,225 rupees per maund (37.32 k.g), dealers said.
